description: This line plot illustrates the training loss evolution over iterations for five different Large Language Model configurations, comparing the performance of StrmLLM and various SepLLM variants. The x-axis, labeled “#Iteration,” is plotted on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 140,000 iterations, with tick marks appearing at regular intervals of 20,000. The y-axis, labeled “Loss,” is also on a linear scale, spanning from 2.4 to 3.4, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The plot contains five distinct lines: a purple dashed line with square markers representing StrmLLM (n=64), a blue solid line with circle markers for SepLLM (n=64), an orange solid line with triangle markers for SepLLM (n=64, H), a red solid line with diamond markers for SepLLM (n=64, H/T), and a dark blue solid line with star markers for SepLLM (n=128). All lines begin at a high loss value near 3.4 at iteration 0 and exhibit a rapid initial decline, followed by a slower, more gradual decrease as iterations progress. By iteration 140,000, the loss values for all configurations have stabilized at a low range, approximately between 2.4 and 2.6, with the StrmLLM (n=64) line showing the highest final loss and the SepLLM (n=128) line showing the lowest.
